decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program extends the firm's core psychiatric treatment competence, so its multidisciplinary teams and own R&D can interpret utilization and refine the offer, and it continues to merit a page of its own.

Custom furniture carpentry builds on established sheltered-workshop production and therapy know-how, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and adjust it, although its sister retail shop was withdrawn, which signals some commercial risk.

Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the firm's mental health and outpatient expertise, so it can learn from early cases and improve the service, though its low website visibility points to modest priority.
Senior living counseling draws directly on deep eldercare knowledge, is low-cost to run, and its prominent placement shows strategic emphasis that supports continued learning.

Meal delivery for seniors is close to the firm's eldercare and catering capabilities, so the firm can interpret early demand and adjust logistics, but as a recently launched, lightly presented service its viability is still uncertain.
